check: With the sound off, is it clear in one second what the scene is about?
fails: The picture does not show what the voiceover says, or shows something the viewer cannot name.

check: Is there ONE element the eye lands on first?
fails: Two or more things of the same size and weight compete (two diagrams, two equal cards), so the eye has nowhere to land.

check: Can the whole frame be taken in at a glance – in the second it is on screen?
fails: It has more than ~6 things to look at, or drawn text the viewer would have to read (code lines, logs, lists of labels, small UI text). A REAL screen (a TikMaker recording or still, a website screenshot) is not a failure for having text, as long as it is cropped to the part that matters, big, and the rest is dimmed or blurred – then the fix is a tighter crop or a bigger zoom, never redrawing it as bars.

check: Can every word be read on a phone?
fails: A label or line looks smaller than about a third of the spoken caption's letters in these frames – on the phone it is too small to read.

check: Is everything inside the safe zone (x 130–900, y 250–1080 of 1080x1920) and clear of the spoken caption?
fails: A picture runs under the caption or off the frame, two elements overlap where they should not, or something sits where the app draws its own buttons: the top ~13% of the frame (TikTok's top bar) or the right ~17% (the like/comment/share column) – there it is covered on the phone.

check: Do the scene's pictures belong to one idea?
fails: Two pictures in one frame tell different things, or a picture has nothing to do with the words said with it.

check: Is there room around the main element?
fails: The frame is crowded edge to edge, or one small thing floats in a big empty frame.

check: Does the scene look different enough from the one before?
fails: It repeats the previous scene's look, so the cut reads as nothing happening.

check: Does it reach the level of the example frames (few big flat shapes and icons, text drawn as grey bars, one orange accent where to look, a lot of calm space)?
fails: It looks like a slide or a diagram dump next to the examples.
